nodes.label: Library Manifest (.library_manifest.json)
nodes.rationale: The central index (source of truth for the 3-level dedup) persisted as JSON and mirrored in memory by LibraryManager; records hold post_hash, clean_url, title, topic, folder path and metadata.

nodes.label: Filesystem-as-Store (No Database)
nodes.rationale: No database: the filesystem is the store. The .library_manifest.json index plus the knowledge_base/ Markdown tree are the source of truth; all data is gitignored and the repo tracks code only.

nodes.label: 3-Level Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Prevents re-downloading an article even when republished under different slugs/tags or campaign params, by checking Medium post hash then sanitized canonical URL then fuzzy title against the manifest.

nodes.label: CI Test Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Runs the full pytest suite on push/PR to main across a Python 3.10-3.13 matrix, installing deps from requirements.txt.

nodes.label: Graphify Architecture Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Generated code-knowledge-graph in graphify-out/ (graph.html force graph, GRAPH_TREE.html, mediumm-callflow.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md) auditing coupling and god-nodes; regenerate rather than hand-edit.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Security Audit (security-audit-skill)
nodes.rationale: 6-phase defensive audit: Run 1 found 3 candidate vulns (arbitrary file overwrite, SSRF via fallback, topic traversal); Run 2 verified all 3 resolved/rejected, leaving 0 active findings.

nodes.label: Anti-SSRF / Anti-DNS-Rebinding Validation Gate
nodes.rationale: Every outbound fetch routes through is_safe_url: http/https only, blocks loopback/RFC1918/cloud-metadata(169.254.169.254)/CGNAT/IPv6-ULA, and resolves via socket.getaddrinfo to defeat DNS rebinding and decimal/hex IP encodings.

nodes.label: 25MB Image Download DoS Guard
nodes.rationale: Inline image downloads are capped at 25MB via a Content-Length check and 64KB chunked reads that abort the stream on overflow, preventing disk-exhaustion DoS.

nodes.label: Filesystem Path Confinement Gate
nodes.rationale: Any filesystem path derived from remote data (title/slug/topic) is sanitized of reserved chars and '..' and asserted relative_to the KB output dir to prevent traversal.

nodes.label: Agentic Zero-Trust Threat Model
nodes.rationale: MCP clients/LLM agents may pass prompt-injected or hallucinated arguments, so all network and filesystem operations pass deterministic pre-execution gates (two-gate zero-trust model).

nodes.label: Single-Engine Thin-Adapter Architecture
nodes.rationale: Core logic lives in one ~2600-line engine (medium_archiver.py) by design; server.py and the skill are thin adapters that import it, so logic is never duplicated across wrappers.

nodes.label: MCP stdio Server Configuration
nodes.rationale: server.py is registered as an MCP stdio server across harnesses (Claude Code, Antigravity/Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, Open Code) via .mcp.json / client config, optionally overriding MEDIUM_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.

nodes.label: 5-Stage HTML to Markdown Sanitization Pipeline
nodes.rationale: HTML becomes LLM-ready Markdown in 5 stages: force UTF-8, strip Shiki-dark/UI residue, download HD images to ./images, markdownify to GFM, then post-process (mojibake + dedup + syntax).

nodes.label: Shiki Dual-Theme Code Block Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Shiki emits parallel light/dark <pre> blocks for CSS theming; the duplicate dark blocks waste ~13-30% of prompt tokens, so github-dark/dark:block nodes are stripped and identical consecutive fences collapsed.

nodes.label: Code-Fence Syntax Classification
nodes.rationale: Terminal commands and HTTP requests were being mislabeled as python; heuristics retag fences as bash/http/json/sql/javascript/python/text for accurate LLM comprehension.

nodes.label: Deterministic UTF-8 Mojibake Repair
nodes.rationale: Mirrors omitting charset=utf-8 make HTTP libs assume ISO-8859-1 per RFC 2616, corrupting UTF-8 bytes; a regex over 2-4 byte sequences re-encodes latin1 then decodes utf-8 to restore typography.

nodes.label: RSS 10-Item Cap Bypass via Monthly Archive Crawling
nodes.norm_label: rss 10-item cap bypass via monthly archive crawling
nodes.rationale: Medium RSS feeds cap at 10 recent items, so building a historical KB requires recursive monthly /archive/YYYY/MM crawling (2024-2026) with a desktop user-agent.

nodes.label: Mirror Rotation Circuit Breaker with Backoff+Jitter
nodes.norm_label: mirror rotation circuit breaker with backoff+jitter
nodes.rationale: On HTTP 502/503/504 or DNS failure a mirror is marked unhealthy for 120-600s and traffic reroutes to remaining mirrors or Medium direct; retries use exponential backoff with jitter (1.2^attempt + rand(0.1,0.3)).

nodes.label: Resumable Download Checkpointing
nodes.rationale: Queue progress (planned/completed/pending) is checkpointed to .download_state.json so Ctrl+C or a network failure resumes exactly where it stopped without re-downloading finished articles.
